correctness.rationale: The Poissonization/top-exponential-spacing coupling is reconstructed from independent first arrivals and Poisson increments. The gap strong law and Exp(1) limit are proved from convergent variances and the exact exponential-max distribution. Uniform geometric domination controls the left-Poisson tail at \(k/s\le\rho<1\). The exponent \(\alpha<\alpha(1-\log\alpha)\) permits deletion of early terms, logarithmic endpoint integration gives \(W^{1-\alpha}/(1-\alpha)\), and conditional Bernoulli variance yields the finite-vector limit. The moment generating coefficient/alternating binomial identity plus a uniform exponential tail bound establish the expectation. Embedded finite checks pass and are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The motivating source explicitly identifies growing sibling indices as a natural gap. The theorem resolves the full interior proportional-to-log-N range for equal probabilities, identifies a new nonexponential Weibull-power universality class, exact mean correction \(\Gamma(1-\alpha)\), and nonlinear finite-dimensional dependence. This is a substantive regime change in a canonical occupancy process, not an arbitrary finite calculation.
